'''Greg Heisler'''<ref name="dt-11098">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11098 The Light Side Deck of Doom v2 0], DeckTech (Greg "rabidjedi" Heisler, 13 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11098/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11098/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018110157/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11098/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''rabidjedi''') posted a [[Light]] [[Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|Agents In The Court]] list on DeckTech in October 2000.
